request.style: English, male rock voice, gritty and intense, electric guitar, bass, drums, moody, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
When the Lord first spoke through Hosea
Go take a wife of prostitution
For the land turns away from the Lord
Great infidelity is their foundation

[Chorus]
He went and took Gomer daughter of Diblaim
And she conceived and bore him a son
A sign of the covenant broken and torn
The daughter of Diblaim in the sun

[Verse]
The command came down from the holy one
To marry the woman who strays
A living sign of the people's ways
Who turn their faces from the sun

[Chorus]
He went and took Gomer daughter of Diblaim
And she conceived and bore him a son
A sign of the covenant broken and torn
The daughter of Diblaim in the sun

[Bridge]
Her father is named in the ancient scroll
Diblaim is the source of the line
A single verse to make it known
The prophet walked on a path divine

[Outro]
Gomer daughter of Diblaim
Bore the son as the word said
The story begins where the heart is led
